home.servicesIntro: From everyday laundry to specialist garment care, we provide professional cleaning and finishing services for individuals and businesses.

steps.title: BOOK YOUR COLLECTION
steps.body: Book online, by WhatsApp or by phone and choose a convenient collection time.

steps.title: WE COLLECT
steps.body: We collect your clothes directly from your home or business.

steps.title: WE CLEAN & CARE
steps.body: Every item is inspected, cleaned using the appropriate process and professionally finished.

steps.title: WE DELIVER

cleaningProcess.title: Our Cleaning Process
cleaningProcess.intro: Experience professional garment care. Our modern cleaning process is designed to provide excellent cleaning results while being gentler on fabrics and the environment.

steps.title: Expert Inspection
steps.desc: We carefully inspect every garment to identify specific fabric needs and areas requiring special attention.

steps.title: Eco Pre-Spotting
steps.desc: Advanced, eco-friendly agents are used to expertly treat stubborn stains like grease or ink before washing.

steps.title: Gentle Water Wash
steps.desc: Our PERC-free system uses ProV'tex technology to give your clothes a highly effective, gentle wash

steps.title: Smart Drying
steps.desc: Garments dry fully inside the machine - helping protect the fabric and maintain its finish, eliminating hang-dry time.

steps.title: Professional Finish
steps.desc: Every garment is carefully finished and returned ready to wear.

about.intro: Since 2005, Super Dry Cleaners has provided professional dry cleaning, laundry and garment care services to customers across Leicester and surrounding areas
story: SuperDryCleaners began with a simple idea: professional garment care shouldn't be complicated or expensive. Since 2005, we've grown into Leicester's trusted choice for dry cleaning, laundry and specialist cleaning — serving homes and businesses alike.

Today we handle everything from everyday wash-and-fold to wedding dress preservation and commercial linen. Our team pays attention to detail, uses eco-friendly products wherever possible, and treats every item as if it were our own.
